item.title: Naver invests in 'BTS Drone Show' company Ubify... expanding physical AI business (네이버, ‘BTS 드론쇼’ 기업 유비파이에 투자…피지컬 AI 사업 확장)
item.description:
Naver has made a surprise investment in Ubify, a drone swarm and autonomous flight platform company, as it moves to expand its business based on physical artificial intelligence (AI). (네이버가 드론 군집·자율 비행 플랫폼 기업 유비파이에 전격 투자하며 피지컬 인공지능(AI)을 기반으로 한 사업 확장에 나선다.)

Naver announced on the 1st that it has invested in Ubify, a global drone specialist. Founded in 2014, Ubify has aggressively targeted overseas markets from its early days and recently became the first domestic drone company to win the '$10 million Export Tower' award. In March, it gained global attention by conducting large-scale drone shows in New York and Seoul to commemorate the release of a new album by the group BTS. However, Naver did not disclose the scale of this investment. (네이버는 글로벌 드론 전문 기업 유비파이에 투자를 단행했다고 1일 밝혔다. 2014년 설립된 유비파이는 초창기부터 국외 시장을 적극적으로 공략해왔고, 최근 국내 드론 기업으론 최초로 ‘1천만 달러 수출의 탑’을 수상했다. 지난 3월엔 그룹 방탄소년단(BTS)의 새 앨범 발매를 기념한 대규모 드론 쇼를 미국 뉴욕과 서울에서 수행하며 전 세계 주목을 받기도 했다. 다만, 네이버는 이번 투자 규모를 밝히지 않았다.)

Through this investment, Naver plans to seek synergies between its AI and cloud technologies and Ubify's drone hardware operation technologies. With the physical AI field, which combines autonomous drones and artificial intelligence, drawing attention, the company expects that integrating these technologies could open up applications in areas such as public and smart city projects. (네이버는 이번 투자를 통해 네이버의 인공지능·클라우드 기술과 유비파이의 드론 하드웨어 운용 기술 등의 시너지를 모색할 계획이다. 자율비행 드론과 인공지능을 결합한 피지컬 인공지능 분야가 주목받는 상황에서, 이같은 기술을 접목해 공공·스마트시티 사업 분야 등으로 활용 가능성도 있다고 기대하고 있다.)

Naver CEO Choi Soo-yeon said, "As the potential for expanding artificial intelligence into the real world through physical AI, autonomous driving, and robotics grows, drones are also one of the important future technology areas," adding, "We expect that combining Naver's physical AI technology capabilities with Ubify's drone technology will create new possibilities in various industrial fields." (최수연 네이버 대표는 “피지컬 인공지능과 자율주행·로보틱스 등 인공지능의 현실 세계 확장 가능성이 커지는 가운데, 드론 역시 중요한 미래 기술 영역 중 하나”라며 “네이버의 피지컬 인공지능 기술 역량과 유비파이의 드론 기술력이 결합해 다양한 산업 분야에서 새로운 가능성을 만들어갈 수 있을 것으로 기대한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Kang Jae-gu j9@hani.co.kr (강재구 기자 j9@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Starbucks to Offer Full Refunds on Prepaid Card Balances for Two Weeks Starting Today (스타벅스, 오늘부터 2주간 선불카드 충전액 전액 환불)
item.description:
Starbucks, which sparked controversy for belittling the 'May 18 Democratic Uprising,' will ease refund criteria for rechargeable prepaid cards for two weeks starting the 1st. Previously, customers could only receive a refund for the remaining balance after using at least 60% of it following the last recharge, but this measure was taken amid strong consumer demands for refunds. (‘5·18 민주화운동’ 폄훼 논란을 빚은 스타벅스가 1일부터 2주간 충전식 선불카드의 환급 기준을 완화한다. 기존에는 최종 충전 후 잔액의 60% 이상을 사용해야만 남은 돈을 돌려받을 수 있었으나, 소비자들의 거센 환불 요구가 이어지자 이런 조처를 내놓은 것이다.)

From today until the 14th, consumers can receive a 100% refund on their balance with no conditions. Cards registered in the app can be applied for through the Starbucks app. On the home screen, select 'PAY' → 'My Card Management' → 'Balance Refund,' then verify your account to complete the application. The refund will be deposited within 7 business days after the application. Physical cards not registered in the app must be applied for in person at a store. Up to 10 cards can be processed per application, and the total refund is provided immediately in cash, up to a limit of ₩100,000. However, refund requests via drive-thru stores will be restricted. (소비자들은 이날부터 오는 14일까지는 조건 없이 잔액을 100% 환급받을 수 있다. 앱에 등록된 카드는 스타벅스 앱을 통해 신청하면 된다. 홈에서 ‘페이(PAY)’→‘내 카드 관리’→‘잔액 환불’을 누른 뒤 계좌를 인증하면 신청이 완료된다. 환급금은 신청 후 7영업일 이내에 입금된다. 앱에 등록되지 않은 실물카드는 매장을 직접 방문해 신청해야 한다. 1회 신청 시 최대 10장까지 가능하며 합산 10만원 한도 내에서 즉시 현금으로 돌려준다. 다만 드라이브스루 매장에서 차량을 통한 환급 접수는 제한된다.)

If you want to receive the refund for a physical card via bank account, it can be done from the 8th to the 14th. After the 8th, visit a Starbucks store and request a QR code for account refund from a partner to submit the request. The refund limit via the app and QR code is up to ₩2 million per person. The total amount of Starbucks card charges is estimated to be in the hundreds of billions of won. (실물카드의 환급금을 계좌로 받고 싶다면 오는 8일부터 14일까지 가능하다. 8일 이후 스타벅스 매장을 방문해 파트너에게 계좌 환급용 큐알(QR)코드를 요청해 접수하는 방식이다. 앱과 큐알코드를 통한 계좌 환급 한도는 1인당 최대 200만원까지다. 스타벅스 카드 충전금의 규모는 4천억원대로 알려져 있다.)

To prevent fraudulent transactions during the refund period (June 1–14), Starbucks will stop selling physical cards in stores. Exchanging mobile gift certificates (e-card exchange tickets) for physical cards is only allowed if the card is used immediately upon exchange. The function to transfer balances between Starbucks cards in the app will also be temporarily suspended during this period. (스타벅스는 환급 기간(6월1일~14일) 동안 부정거래를 막기 위해 매장에서 실물카드 판매를 중지한다. 모바일 상품권(e카드 교환권)을 실물카드로 교환하는 것은 교환 즉시 사용하는 경우에만 허용된다. 앱에서 스타벅스 카드 간 잔액을 이전하는 기능도 이 기간 일시중단된다.)

Through its official application, Starbucks stated, “We sincerely apologize to everyone who was hurt by marketing containing incorrect expressions related to the May 18 Democratic Uprising. We deeply feel responsible for this issue and will temporarily ease the refund criteria for Starbucks cards.” (스타벅스는 공식 애플리케이션을 통해 “5·18 민주화운동과 관련된 잘못된 표현이 담긴 마케팅으로 상처받으신 모든 분께 진심으로 사죄드린다”며 “이번 사안에 대해 책임을 통감하며 일시적으로 스타벅스 카드 환급 기준을 완화한다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the May 18 Memorial Foundation and other May-related groups sent an official letter of protest to Starbucks’ US headquarters regarding the ‘Tank Day’ marketing incident. In an English letter addressed to the CEO and board of directors of Starbucks US headquarters, the groups called for a thorough investigation, accountability for those responsible, and an official apology. (한편, 5·18기념재단 등 오월단체는 스타벅스 코리아의 5·18 ‘탱크데이’ 마케팅 사태와 관련해 미국 스타벅스 본사에 공식 항의 서한을 발송했다고 이날 밝혔다. 이달 단체는 미국 스타벅스 본사 최고경영자(CEO)와 이사회 앞으로 보낸 영문 서한에서 철저한 진상조사와 책임자 문책, 공식 사과를 촉구했다.)

Reporter Lee Ju-bin yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Cancelled Flight Tickets Refunded with Vouchers Instead of Cash…Trip.com Violated E-Commerce Act (항공권 취소했는데 현금 대신 바우처…트립닷컴 전자상거래법 위반)
item.description:
The travel booking platform Trip.com has been sanctioned by the Fair Trade Commission for refunding consumers with airline vouchers instead of the original payment method when they withdrew their flight ticket purchases. (소비자가 항공권 구매를 철회할 때 결제한 수단이 아닌 항공사 바우처로 환급해준 여행 예약 플랫폼 트립닷컴이 공정거래위원회 제재를 받았다.)

On the 1st, the Fair Trade Commission announced that it has issued a corrective order, a reporting order, and imposed a total fine of 10 million won on Trip.com Travel Singapore Private Limited (Trip.com Singapore) and Trip.com Korea for violations of the E-Commerce Act. The reporting order requires the companies to report quarterly, for one year from the date of the corrective order, any instances where refunds were made using a method disadvantageous to consumers rather than the method the consumer used for payment. (공정위는 1일 트립닷컴 트래블 싱가포르 프라이빗 리미티드(트립닷컴 싱가포르) 및 트립닷컴코리아의 전자상거래법 위반행위에 시정명령과 보고명령, 과태료 총 1000만원을 부과한다고 밝혔다. 보고명령은 시정명령을 받은 날부터 1년간 소비자가 결제한 수단이 아닌 소비자에게 불리한 수단으로 환급한 경우 그 내용을 3개월 단위로 보고하도록 하는 조처다.)

According to the FTC investigation, Trip.com Singapore and Korea refunded some transactions where consumers withdrew their flight ticket purchases between February 2020 and July of last year using airline vouchers instead of the consumer's payment method. Under the E-Commerce Act, mail-order sellers are obligated to refund payments using a method no less favorable than the consumer's payment method, and the FTC determined that Trip.com violated this provision. (공정위 조사 결과, 트립닷컴 싱가포르·코리아는 2020년 2월부터 지난해 7월까지 소비자가 항공권 구매를 철회한 일부 거래에 대해 소비자가 결제한 수단이 아닌 항공사의 바우처로 환급한 것으로 나타났다. 전자상거래법에 따라 통신판매업자는 소비자가 결제한 수단보다 불리하지 않은 수단으로 대금을 환급해줄 의무가 있는데, 공정위는 트립닷컴이 이를 위반했다고 판단했다.)

Additionally, Trip.com Singapore and Korea notified consumers during the flight ticket booking, issuance, and cancellation process that refunds could only be provided via airline vouchers. They used pop-up screens or similar methods to display messages such as "In accordance with airline regulations, refunds may only be provided as airline vouchers in some cases" and "Refunds are only provided in the form of airline vouchers." The FTC viewed this as an act of hindering consumers' right to withdraw their purchase by informing them of rules different from those stipulated by law. (트립닷컴 싱가포르·코리아는 또 항공권 예약·발권·취소 과정에서 환불금액이 항공사 바우처로만 제공될 수 있다고 고지했다. ‘항공사 규정에 의거해 경우에 따라 환불금액이 항공사 바우처로만 제공될 수 있습니다’, ‘환불은 항공사 바우처 형태로만 제공됩니다’ 등 문구를 팝업 화면 등으로 안내하는 방식이었다. 공정위는 이를 법에서 정한 규정과 다른 사실을 알려 소비자의 청약 철회를 방해한 행위로 봤다.)

Furthermore, Trip.com Singapore operated without registering as a mail-order seller from November 2017 to September of last year, and Trip.com Korea did so from April 2020 to January of last year, while selling flight tickets to domestic consumers through Trip.com's online mall. (아울러 트립닷컴 싱가포르는 2017년 11월부터 지난해 9월까지, 트립닷컴코리아는 2020년 4월부터 지난해 1월까지 통신판매업 신고를 하지 않고 트립닷컴 온라인몰에서 국내 소비자에게 항공권을 판매했다.)

However, the FTC noted that it took into account that Trip.com Singapore and Korea have completed remedial measures for consumers, such as cash refunds, for cases previously refunded with airline vouchers. Since July 31 of last year, they have also stopped selling tickets from airlines that only refund ticket payments with vouchers. Additionally, Trip.com Singapore and Korea have completed their mail-order seller registrations. (다만 공정위는 트립닷컴 싱가포르·코리아가 기존에 항공사 바우처로 환급해준 건에 대해 현금 환불 등 소비자 피해 회복 조처를 완료했다는 점을 고려했다고 설명했다. 지난해 7월31일부터는 바우처로만 항공권 대금을 환급하는 항공사의 항공권을 판매하지 않고 있기도 하다. 또 트립닷컴 싱가포르·코리아는 통신판매업 신고를 완료했다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-ju kyj@hani.co.kr (김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Middle East War Fallout Reverses Domestic Institutions' Foreign Securities into Downtrend (중동전쟁 여파, 국내 기관 외화증권 하락세로 반전)
item.description:
The balance of foreign securities investments held by domestic institutional investors, including asset management firms and insurance companies, has decreased by just over $4 billion from the start of this year through March. This is attributed to valuation losses stemming from the aftermath of the war between the United States and Israel-Iran. (국내 자산운용사와 보험사 등 기관투자가가 보유한 외화증권 투자 잔액이 올해 들어 3월까지 40억달러 남짓 줄어든 것으로 나타났다. 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 여파로 평가 손실이 발생한 탓으로 풀이된다.)

According to the "Trends in Foreign Securities Investment by Major Institutional Investors in the First Quarter" data released by the Bank of Korea on the 1st, the balance (based on market value) as of the end of March stood at $503.33 billion, down $4.26 billion compared to the end of last year ($507.59 billion). On a quarterly basis, the foreign securities balance of major domestic institutional investors had been on a steady upward trend since the fourth quarter of 2024 (a decrease of $6.75 billion). The foreign securities balance of South Korea's major institutional investors had surpassed $500 billion for the first time in the fourth quarter of last year, following $387.8 billion at the end of 2023 and $420.7 billion in 2024. This was the result of valuation gains on both foreign stocks and bonds, driven by the growth of the U.S. economy and expectations for the development of the artificial intelligence (AI) industry, which boosted stock prices in major countries and lowered U.S. Treasury bond yields. ( 한국은행이 1일 내놓은 ‘1분기중 주요 기관투자가의 외화증권 투자 동향’ 자료를 보면, 3월말 현재 잔액(시가 기준)이 5033억3천만달러로 지난해 말(5075억9천만달러)에 견줘 42억6천만달러 감소했다. 분기 기준 국내 주요 기관투자가의 외화증권 잔액은 2024년 4분기(67억5천만달러 감소) 이후엔 줄곧 큰 폭의 증가세를 이어왔다. 우리나라 주요 기관투자가의 외화증권 잔액은 2023년말 3878억달러, 2024년 4207억달러에 이어 지난해 4분기에 처음으로 5천억달러를 넘어선 바 있다. 미국 경제 성장세와 인공지능(AI) 산업 발전에 대한 기대감 덕에 주요국의 주가가 상승하고 미국 국채 금리가 하락하면서 외국 주식 및 채권 모두 평가 이익을 낸 데 따른 결과였다.)

Regarding the reversal of this trend this year, the Bank of Korea explained that "valuation losses on both foreign stocks and bonds were greater than net investments due to the stock price correction and the rise in U.S. Treasury bond yields caused by the Middle East war." In the fourth quarter of last year, the U.S. Standard & Poor's (S&P) 500 index rose by 2.3%, but in the first quarter of this year, it fell by 4.6%. The yield on 10-year U.S. Treasury bonds jumped from 4.17% at the end of December last year to 4.32% at the end of March this year. <<> Looking at trends by investment entity, the investment balance of asset management firms stood at $353.26 billion as of the end of March, down $4.75 billion from the end of last year, recording the largest decrease. Securities companies reduced their balance by $400 million, insurance companies by $40 million, while foreign exchange banks saw an increase of $930 million. Here, the balance for asset management firms is based on trust and proprietary accounts, while for foreign exchange banks, insurance companies, and securities firms, it is based on proprietary accounts. <<> By product type, foreign stocks decreased from $292.53 billion at the end of last year to $288.52 billion at the end of March this year, a reduction of $4.01 billion, accounting for most of the total decrease. Foreign bonds decreased by $450 million, while the balance of "Korean Paper" (foreign currency-denominated securities issued by domestic residents abroad) increased by $200 million. The decline in the foreign bond balance was analyzed as resulting from valuation losses due to the rise in U.S. Treasury bond yields amid inflation concerns caused by higher oil prices. The increase in the Korean Paper balance was centered around foreign exchange banks and is attributed to the upward trend in the stock prices of major domestic companies. <<> Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr ( 올해 들어 이런 분위기가 반전된 데 대해 한은은 “중동 전쟁에 따른 주가 조정 및 미 국채 금리 상승으로 외국 주식 및 채권 모두 순투자보다 평가손실이 더 크게 발생했기 때문”으로 풀이했다. 지난해 4분기 중 미국 스탠더드앤푸어스(S&P)500 지수는 2.3% 상승한 반면, 올해 1분기엔 4.6% 하락했다. 미 국채금리(10년물) 금리는 지난해 12월 말 4.17%에서 올해 3월 말 4.32%로 뛰었다.)

item.title: Hanwha "Deeply Apologizes for Daejeon Business Site Explosion... Thoroughly Investigating the Cause" (한화 “에어로 대전사업장 폭발 깊이 사과…원인 철저 규명”)
item.description:
Hanwha Group and Hanwha Aerospace issued a statement on the 1st regarding the explosion accident at the Daejeon business site, saying, "We will thoroughly investigate the cause of the accident to ensure such a tragic incident never recurs." (한화그룹과 한화에어로스페이스가 1일 대전사업장 폭발 사고와 관련해 “사고 원인을 철저히 규명해 다시는 이런 참담한 사고가 재발하지 않도록 하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Hanwha Group and Hanwha Aerospace released a statement on the same day, stating, "We are deeply saddened and regretful that five precious employees lost their lives in the accident that occurred this morning at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon business site." They added, "We pray for the souls of the deceased and offer our heartfelt condolences to the bereaved families." They further said, "We wish a swift recovery to the employees injured in the accident and will spare no support in their treatment." (한화그룹과 한화에어로스페이스는 이날 입장문을 내어 “오늘 오전 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 발생한 사고로 소중한 직원 다섯 분이 숨져 비통하고 안타깝다”며 “숨진 직원들의 명복을 빌며 유가족께 진심으로 위로의 말씀을 드린다”고 했다. 이어 “사고로 부상을 입은 직원들의 빠른 쾌유를 빌며, 치료에 모든 지원을 아끼지 않겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Hanwha Aerospace explained that immediately after the accident, a meeting was held at the Seoul headquarters chaired by CEO Son Jae-il, and that Son moved to the accident site right after the meeting. The company stated that a response headquarters has been set up at the accident site to manage the situation in cooperation with authorities such as the fire department and police. (한화에어로스페이스는 사고 직후 손재일 대표이사 주재로 서울 본사에서 대책회의를 열었고, 손 대표는 회의 뒤 바로 사고 현장으로 이동했다고 설명했다. 회사는 사고 현장에 대책본부를 마련해 소방·경찰 등 관계 당국과 사고 수습을 진행하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

Hanwha Group said, "We are currently confirming the specific circumstances of the accident and the extent of the damage," and added, "We will thoroughly investigate the cause of the accident to ensure such a tragic incident never recurs." They continued, "We once again bow our heads and deeply apologize to the people." (한화그룹은 “구체적인 사고 경위와 피해 상황은 확인 중에 있다”며 “사고 원인을 철저히 규명해 다시는 이런 참담한 사고가 재발하지 않도록 하겠다”고 했다. 이어 “다시 한 번 국민 여러분께 고개 숙여 깊이 사과드린다”고 했다.)

At around 10:59 a.m. on this day, an explosion occurred at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon business site in Oesam-dong, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. The Daejeon business site, where the accident occurred, is where Hanwha Aerospace develops and produces propulsion systems and handles propellant mixing and charging. (이날 오전 10시59분께 대전 유성구 외삼동 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 폭발 사고가 발생했다. 사고가 난 대전사업장은 한화에어로스페이스의 추진기관 개발·생산과 추진제 혼화·충전 등이 이뤄지는 곳이다.)

item.title: Gobne Chicken to Reduce Pre-Cooking Weight of Thigh Meat Menus by 100g… Due to AI Outbreak (굽네치킨, 닭다리살 메뉴 중량 100g 줄이기로…‘조류AI’ 등 영향)
item.description:
Gobne Chicken has decided to reduce the pre-cooking weight of some of its menus. This is a result of the increased burden on raw materials due to unstable chicken supply caused by the recent spread of avian influenza (AI). (굽네치킨이 일부 메뉴의 조리 전 중량을 줄이기로 했다. 최근 확산한 조류 인플루엔자(AI)의 영향으로 닭고기 수급이 불안정해지면서 원재료 부담이 커진 데 따른 영향이다.)

GnFood, which operates the chicken franchise Gobne Chicken, announced on the 1st that it will adjust the operating standards for its boneless chicken thigh meat, wing-bone, and whole thigh menus. Accordingly, the pre-cooking weight of the boneless chicken thigh meat menu will be reduced from the existing 800g to 700g, a decrease of 100g. ( 치킨 프랜차이즈 굽네치킨을 운영하는 지앤푸드는 닭다리살 순살·윙봉·통다리 메뉴의 운영 기준을 조정한다고 1일 밝혔다. 이에 따라 닭다리살 순살 메뉴는 조리 전 중량이 기존 800g에서 700g으로 100g 줄어든다.)

The company explained that, amid prolonged raw material price increases and supply burden, it decided on this weight adjustment to maintain consumer prices while preserving the taste and quality of the product. It added that while it had absorbed the burden of raw material price increases on its own and maintained the principle of using 100% domestic chicken thigh meat, the growing consumer preference for chicken thigh meat and the mass culling of parent stock and broilers due to the aftermath of avian influenza have increased supply pressure. ( 회사 쪽은 원료 가격 상승과 수급 부담이 장기화되는 상황에서, 소비자 가격은 유지하되 제품의 맛과 품질을 지키기 위해 이번 중량 조정을 결정했다고 설명했다. 그동안 원료 가격 인상 부담을 자체적으로 흡수하며 100% 국내산 닭다리살 사용 원칙을 유지했지만, 닭다리살에 대한 소비자 선호도가 늘고 조류 인플루엔자 여파로 종계와 육계의 대량 살처분이 이어지면서 공급 부담이 커졌다는 것이다.)

The company stated that it is sequentially informing customers about the related content through major channels such as its official website and application, and is also providing pre-cooking weight information for each menu. ( 회사는 관련 내용을 공식 누리집과 애플리케이션 등 주요 채널을 통해 순차적으로 안내하고 있으며, 메뉴별 조리 전 중량 정보도 제공하고 있다고 밝혔다. )

Reporter Seo Hyemi ham@hani.co.kr ( 서혜미 기자 ham@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "South Korea Ranks 3rd Globally in Notable AI Releases... Strengths in 'Physical AI'" (“한국, 주목할 만한 AI 출시 세계 3위…‘피지컬 AI’ 강점”)
item.description:
According to Stanford University's '2026 AI Index' indicators, South Korea ranked 3rd globally in the release of notable AI models and 18th in AI adoption rate. (미국 스탠포드대학의 ‘2026년 인공지능(AI) 인덱스’ 지표에서 한국이 ‘주목할 만한 인공지능 모델’ 출시에서 세계 3위, 인공지능 도입률에서 세계 18위로 집계됐다.)

A report titled "Status and Leapfrog Challenges of South Korea's AI Industry," published on the 1st by the POSCO Research Institute after utilizing and analyzing Stanford University's Human-Centered AI (HAI) '2026 AI Index' indicators, shows that in the second half of last year, South Korea's AI adoption rate ranked 18th globally, up seven notches from 25th in the first half of last year. The increase rate (+4.8 percentage points) was evaluated as the highest worldwide. As AI deployment surged simultaneously in both corporate and public sectors, the number of installed industrial robots reached 30,600 units, ranking 4th globally. China ranked 1st (295,000 units), Japan 2nd (44,500 units), and the U.S. 3rd (34,200 units). South Korea maintained its top global position in 'robot density'—the number of robots per 10,000 workers—at 1,012 units. (1일 포스코경영연구원이 스탠포드대학 인간중심 인공지능연구소(HAI)의 ‘2026 인공지능 인덱스’ 지표를 활용·분석해 내놓은 ‘한국 인공지능 산업의 위상과 도약 과제’ 보고서를 보면, 지난해 하반기 우리나라 인공지능 도입률은 세계 18위로 작년 상반기(25위)보다 7단계 상승했다. 도입률 증가폭(+4.8%포인트)은 세계 1위로 평가됐다. 기업·공공부문에서 인공지능 배치가 동시에 급증하면서 산업용 로봇 설치 대수는 3만600대로 세계 4위로 나타났다. 1위 중국(29만5000대), 2위 일본(4만4500대), 3위는 미국(3만4200대)이다. 노동자 1만명당 로봇 대수를 뜻하는 ‘로봇 밀도’는 우리나라가 1012대로 세계 1위를 유지했다.)

The 'Stanford AI Index Report' is a comprehensive AI analysis report published annually since 2017, aggregating and analyzing data across all fields including R&D and technical performance. It is widely cited by governments and businesses as an independent and neutral reference. (‘스탠포드 인공지능 인덱스 리포트’는 2017년부터 매년 발간하는 인공지능 종합 분석보고서로, 연구개발 및 기술성능 등 전 분야의 데이터를 집계·분석하는데, 독립적·중립적으로 평가받아 각국 정부·기업이 참고자료로 자주 인용한다.)

The report evaluated that South Korea's industrial sector has entered a 'transition momentum' stage where AI absorption is accelerating, with its strengths particularly prominent in 'physical AI'—the application of AI to factories and robots. In terms of technical performance and innovation capability, South Korea released five 'notable AI models' in large language models (LLMs) last year (from LG Research, Naver, SK Telecom, Upstage, and NCsoft), ranking 3rd after the U.S. (50 cases) and China (30 cases). The report noted that South Korea's LLMs are concentrated in mid-sized models with around 30 billion parameters, contrasting with the hundreds of billions to trillions in top-tier U.S. and Chinese models, reflecting a strategy of differentiation through 'cost efficiency' and 'Korean language specialization'. (이 보고서는 한국 산업계는 인공지능 흡수가 가속화되는 ‘전환 모멘텀’ 단계에 진입했으며, 특히 공장·로봇에 인공지능을 적용하는 ‘피지컬 인공지능’ 분야에서 한국의 강점이 두드러진다고 평가했다. 기술적 성능과 혁신 역량의 경우 지난해 한국이 거대언어모델(LLM)에서 ‘주목할 만한 인공지능 모델’ 5건(엘지연구원·네이버·에스케이텔레콤·업스테이지·엔씨소프트)을 출시해, 미국(50건)·중국(30건)에 이어 3위에 올랐다. 보고서는 한국의 거대언어모델은 매개변수 약 300억개 규모의 중형급에 집중돼 있어, 수천억~조 단위인 미국·중국 최상위 모델과 달리 ‘비용 효율’과 ‘한국어 특화’ 측면에서 차별화하는 전략을 보이고 있다고 진단했다.)

South Korea also topped the world in AI patent applications per capita for the second consecutive year, with 14.31 applications per 100,000 people, positioning it as the most innovation-active country relative to population size. Luxembourg came 2nd (12.25 cases), China 3rd (6.95 cases), and the U.S. 4th (4.68 cases). However, the report noted, "Although Samsung Electronics, LG Electronics, and SK Telecom account for most patent applications, the number of patent applications does not directly guarantee commercialization success or model quality. Compared to world-leading models, the absolute performance of South Korea's own models still lags significantly behind the top U.S. and Chinese models." According to the report, South Korea's AI market size was estimated at approximately $9.06 billion as of last year, representing a 1.6% share of the global market ($581.7 billion)—slightly lower than South Korea's GDP share of global total output (approximately 1.8%). (인공지능 특허 출원 수에서도 한국은 인구 10만명당 14.31건으로 2년 연속 세계 1위를 지키면서, 인구 규모 대비 혁신 활동이 가장 활발한 나라로 평가됐다. 2위는 룩셈부르크(12.25건), 3위는 중국(6.95건), 4위는 미국(4.68건)이었다. 보고서는 다만 “삼성전자·엘지전자·에스케이텔레콤 등이 특허 출원의 다수를 차지하고 있지만 특허 출원 수가 상용화 성공과 모델 품질을 직접 보증하지 않는다”며, “세계 최고 수준 모델과 비교하면 한국 자체 모델의 절대적인 성능은 미국·중국 최상위 모델에 견줘 여전히 큰 격차가 있다”고 평가했다. 보고서에 따르면, 한국의 인공지능 시장 규모는 지난해 기준 약 90억6천만달러로 추산됐다. 글로벌(5817억달러) 대비 점유율 1.6%로, 글로벌 세계총생산에서 한국 국내총생산이 차지하는 비중(약 1.8%)에 견줘 다소 낮은 수준이다.)

Regarding global AI trends, the report stated, "AI has entered a phase of accelerated growth in all dimensions—performance, diffusion, and investment—as well as in quantitative and qualitative aspects." It noted that the 'SWE (Software Engineering) Coding Benchmark,' a key indicator measuring the performance of AI coding agents, saw its completion rate (problem-solving rate) leap from 60% to nearly 100% (human baseline) within a year. Additionally, the AI adoption rate in global enterprises reached 88%, and generative AI, just three years after its launch, has been used by 53% of the global population, spreading faster than PCs (about 10 years) and the internet (about 7 years). (보고서는 글로벌 인공지능 동향과 관련해, “인공지능이 성능·확산·투자 등 모든 차원에서 또 양적 및 질적 측면에서 가속 성장하는 국면에 진입”한 가운데 인공지능 코딩 에이전트의 성능을 측정하는 대표 지표인 ‘에스더블유이(SWE) 코딩 벤치마크’의 경우 1년 만에 완료율(문제 해결률)이 60%에서 약 100%(인간 기준선) 수준으로 도약했다고 평가했다. 또 글로벌 기업에서 인공지능 채택률은 88% 도달했고, 생성형 인공지능은 출시 3년 만에 글로벌 인구 53%가 사용하면서 기존의 피시(PC·약 10년) 및 인터넷(약 7년)보다 빠른 확산세를 보이고 있다고 밝혔다.)

However, the report diagnosed that as AI development rapidly concentrates around enterprises, a phenomenon of concentration among a few big tech firms and reduced information disclosure is emerging. Last year, over 90% of 'notable frontier AI models' were released by the industry, with only 7 out of 87 total models coming from academia or government. Furthermore, major labs like Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI have discontinued the practice of disclosing information such as 'training dataset size and training time,' causing the transparency index to drop from 58 to 40. The report assessed, "While performance improves, reliability and explainability are declining," and the disconnect between capability and responsibility is emerging as a global policy challenge. (보고서는 그러나, 인공지능 개발이 기업 중심으로 빠르게 쏠리면서, 소수 빅테크로의 집중과 정보 공개 축소 현상이 함께 나타나고 있다고 진단했다. 지난해 ‘주목할 만한 프런티어 인공지능 모델’의 90% 이상이 산업계에서 출시됐으며, 학계·정부에서 내놓은 모델은 전체 87건 중 7건에 불과했다. 나아가 구글·앤트로픽·오픈에이아이(AI) 등 주요 랩에서 ‘학습 데이터셋 규모와 학습 시간’ 정보를 그동안 공개해온 관행이 사라져, 투명성 지수가 58에서 40으로 하락했다. 보고서는 “성능은 좋아지지만 신뢰성과 설명 가능성은 오히려 떨어져” 능력과 책임이 함께 가지 못하는 현상이 세계적인 정책 과제로 떠오르고 있다고 평가했다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Gyewan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: From enemy detection to counterattack, AI-led NLL engagement… What about the gap in ‘human control’? (적 탐지부터 반격까지, AI가 주도하는 NLL 교전…‘인간 통제’의 공백은?)
item.description:
An enemy vessel intruded below the Northern Limit Line (NLL) in the West Sea. The AI-based autonomous unmanned surface vessel ‘Haegum’ responded. As the intelligent command and control system fused data collected from multiple domains—sea, air, and satellites—in real time to generate a high-precision operational map, the ‘AI tactical staff officer’ immediately created several tactical plans containing options such as reconnaissance and combat, recommending them to the human commander. The commander selected one and executed it. The time from enemy detection to operational planning, warning shots, disabling shots, and collision attacks was reduced by over 90% compared to when military personnel made decisions directly. <<> This was the scene from a demonstration of ‘AI-based unmanned surface vessel intelligent command and control’ conducted by defense company LIG Defense & Aerospace (LIG D&A, formerly LIG Nex1) on the 27th off the coast of Busan Yeongdo-gu, Korea Maritime and Ocean University. The demonstration, attended by military officials and others, involved launching four Haegum vessels developed by the company into the actual sea. It simulated a battlefield-like environment with destroyers, torpedoes, suicide drones, and sonobuoys (acoustic detection buoys) via a simulator, which was then linked to the Haegum through satellite communication. <<> LIG Defense & Aerospace announced on the 1st, “We have succeeded in verifying AI-based multi-purpose unmanned system technology that implements ‘speed’ and ‘integration’—key competitive advantages on the future battlefield—for the first time in South Korea.” It added, “If this system is adopted, the time from enemy detection to commander decision and engagement can be drastically reduced to about one-tenth of the current level, providing an overwhelming advantage in modern warfare. Additionally, unmanned operations are possible 24/7 without personnel rotation or gaps.” <<> In this demonstration, the AI solution supporting human commander decision-making was implemented through collaboration with Palantir, an AI company whose main clients include the U.S. Department of War. LIG Defense & Aerospace stated that ‘AI-based command and control’ was carried out in five stages for a simulated engagement with an enemy vessel and seven stages for a simulated sinking of an enemy submarine. Palantir’s ‘Maven Smart System’ played a key role in the war the U.S. initiated against Iran. It analyzes vast battlefield data to identify target candidates and coordinates, prioritizes attacks, and evaluates operational outcomes, transforming tasks that once took months or weeks into ‘real-time’ execution. <<> However, the drastic reduction in decision-making time in warfare leads to a reduction in human control to verify errors such as misfires. The bombing of an elementary school in Iran, which could have been prevented if a soldier had visually confirmed the footage, is a prime example. The NLL, assumed as the operational space in this demonstration, is an area where accidental engagements between North and South Korea pose a high risk of escalating into a local or full-scale war. Despite simplified rules of engagement following battles like the Yeonpyeong naval skirmish, the principle that ‘the use of force is a last resort and should be kept to a minimum’ is still adhered to. <<> The United Nations Human Rights Council Advisory Committee expressed concern in a report last year, stating that “autonomous weapons systems weaken human oversight and accountability, and AI-based decision-making creates a vacuum of transparency and responsibility.” A LIG Defense & Aerospace official said, “The AI only makes recommendations; the final choice and execution of actions like engagements are carried out through the human commander at every stage. item.title: ‘9,000 Points’ Within Reach: ‘Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix Leveraged ETFs’ Turnover Hits 2,000%… Day Trading Frenzy (‘9천피’ 코앞 ‘삼전닉스 레버리지 ETF’ 회전율 2천%까지…단타도 과열)
item.description:
Ahead of the opening of ‘Computex,’ Asia’s largest information technology (IT) exhibition, news that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang would meet with major domestic business leaders sent the KOSPI soaring past 8,700 for the first time in history on the 1st. (아시아 최대 정보기술(IT) 박람회 ‘컴퓨텍스’ 개막을 앞두고 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 국내 주요 기업인과 만난다는 소식이 전해지면서 코스피가 1일 사상 첫 8700을 돌파했다.)

According to data from the Korea Exchange, the KOSPI closed at 8,788.38, up 3.68% from the previous trading day. It surged during the session, briefly hitting 8,874.16. Just four trading days after achieving the ‘8,000-point’ milestone at the closing bell, the index has now swiftly approached the 9,000-point level. The 11th buy-side sidecar of the year was also triggered on the main bourse. (한국거래소 수치를 보면, 이날 코스피는 전 거래일 대비 3.68% 오른 8788.38에 거래를 마쳤다. 장중 급등세를 보이며 한때 8874.16까지도 치솟았다. 종가 기준 ‘8천피’를 달성한 지 불과 4거래일 만에 ‘9천피’에 훌쩍 다가선 모습이다. 유가증권시장에서 올해 11번째 매수 사이드카도 발동했다.)

Top market-cap stocks like Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Hyundai Motor rose 10.09%, 1.29%, and 3.73%, respectively, from the previous trading day. Samsung Electronics, excluding preferred shares, surpassed a market cap of 2,000 trillion won for the first time in the history of the main bourse. This week, as CEO Jensen Huang’s schedule to visit Korea and meet with LG Group Chairman Koo Kwang-mo was revealed, LG Electronics skyrocketed by 29.86%. Naver and Doosan also surged by 16.03% and 11.71%, respectively. (시가총액 상위 종목인 삼성전자와 에스케이하이닉스, 현대차는 전 거래일 대비 각각 10.09%, 1.29%, 3.73% 올랐다. 삼성전자는 우선주를 제외하고 유가증권시장 역사상 처음으로 시가총액 2천조원을 돌파했다. 이번 주 젠슨 황 최고경영자가 한국을 방문해 구광모 엘지그룹 회장을 만나는 일정이 공개되면서 엘지전자는 29.86% 폭등했다. 네이버와 두산도 각각 16.03%, 11.71% 급등했다.)

Amid the continuous rally in the KOSPI, concerns about short-term overheating are growing, particularly centered on single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. Some of these products have daily turnover rates reaching up to 2,000%, indicating an extreme trend of speculative day trading spreading like a fad. (연일 계속되는 코스피 급등세에 삼성전자·하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)를 중심으로 단기 과열에 대한 우려 목소리도 커진다. 이들 중 일일 회전율(손바뀜)이 최대 2000%에 달하는 상품도 있어, 극단적인 ‘단타’ 거래가 유행처럼 번지고 있는 양상이다.)

Reporter Kim Ga-yoon gayoon@hani.co.kr (김가윤 기자 gayoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: They Dreamed of Being Adult Learners... 12.7% of Student Loan Delinquents Are Aged 50 or Older (만학도 꿈꿨지만…학자금 대출 연체자 12.7%가 ‘50대 이상’)
item.description:
It has been found that borrowers aged 50 or older who took out student loans to enter college later in life and are now repaying after defaulting account for 12.7% of the total. Even 17 septuagenarians were counted as delinquent. This suggests that many who knocked on the doors of universities again with dreams of becoming adult learners ended up burdened with debt after graduation. (늦은 나이에 대학에 진학하기 위해 학자금대출을 받았다가 연체한 뒤 상환 중인 50대 이상 채무자가 전체의 12.7%에 이르는 것으로 나타났다. 70대 연체자도 17명으로 집계됐다. 만학도의 꿈을 안고 다시 학교 문을 두드렸으나 졸업 뒤 빚 부담을 짊어지고 있는 이들이 적지 않은 셈이다.)

According to the Korea Student Aid Foundation on the 1st, as of the end of last year, a total of 37,943 people were repaying after being delinquent for six months or more on ‘general repayment student loans.’ By age group, those in their 30s were the largest group at 19,401 (51.1%), followed by those in their 40s at 8,078 (21.3%), and those in their 20s at 5,642 (14.9%). (1일 한국장학재단에 따르면 지난해 말 기준 ‘일반상환 학자금대출’을 받은 뒤 6개월 이상 연체했다가 현재 상환 중인 이들은 총 3만7943명으로 집계됐다. 연령별로는 30대가 1만9401명(51.1%)으로 가장 많았고, 40대 8078명(21.3%), 20대 5642명(14.9%) 순이었다.)

Although the primary age for attending university is the 20s, those aged 50 or older reached 4,821 (12.7%). This includes 3,723 (9.8%) in their 50s, 1,081 (2.8%) in their 60s, and 17 in their 70s. Notably, the proportion of those aged 50 or older has been increasing yearly, from 10.3% in 2023 to 11.5% in 2024, and 12.7% last year. Since these statistics only include borrowers currently repaying delinquent debts, the actual number of delinquents is likely higher. (주된 대학 진학 연령대가 20대이지만, 50대 이상도 4821명(12.7%)에 달했다. 50대가 3723명(9.8%), 60대가 1081명(2.8%)이고, 70대도 17명이었다. 특히 50대 이상 비중은 2023년 10.3%에서 2024년 11.5%, 지난해 12.7%로 매년 높아지고 있다. 해당 통계는 연체 채무를 상환 중인 채무자만 추린 것이어서, 실제 연체자 수는 더 많을 가능성이 크다.)

A significant portion of delinquents aged 50 or older are estimated to be adult learners who entered universities through special admissions tracks (for those aged 30 or older) or who enrolled in graduate school mid-career. Student loans are broadly divided into ‘income-contingent repayment’ and ‘general repayment’ loans. Income-contingent repayment loans defer principal and interest payments until a certain income level is reached and are only available to those aged 35 or younger, so they are mainly used by undergraduate students in their 20s. (50대 이상 연체자 상당수는 각 대학이 마련한 만학도 전형(30살 이상 대상)으로 입학했거나 직장생활 도중에 대학원에 진학한 이들로 추정된다. 학자금대출은 크게 ‘취업상환’과 ‘일반상환’ 학자금 대출로 나뉜다. 취업상환 대출은 일정 소득이 생길 때까지 원리금 상환이 유예되고, 만 35살 이하만 받을 수 있어 주로 20대 학부생들이 이용한다.)

In contrast, general repayment loans are available to those aged 55 or younger who enroll in university or graduate school, up to age 59, and repayment obligations begin immediately after the loan is taken out, making them popular among adult learners with an income base. This trend can be interpreted as more people enrolling in universities or graduate schools later in life for retraining or re-employment but failing to secure stable income afterward, leading to defaults. Lim Eun-hee, a researcher at the Higher Education Research Institute, said, “Older delinquents on general repayment student loans are more likely to be adult learners who started studying later in life, rather than those who attended university in their 20s to 30s and fell into long-term delinquency.” (반면 일반상환 대출은 만 55살 이하에 대학·대학원에 입학한 경우 만 59살까지 받을 수 있고, 대출 직후부터 상환 의무가 발생하기 때문에 소득 기반이 있는 만학도들이 이용하고 있다. 재교육·재취업을 위해 늦은 나이에 대학·대학원에 진학했으나 이후 안정적인 소득을 확보하지 못해 연체되는 이들이 늘고 있다고 해석할 수 있다. 임은희 대학교육연구소 연구원은 “일반상환 학자금의 고령 연체자는 20∼30대에 대학을 다니다 장기 연체를 한 경우라기보다, 늦은 나이에 공부를 시작한 만학도일 가능성이 크다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Ahn Tae-ho: eco@hani.co.kr (안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Sogang University Chemistry Department Professor Kang Min Ok’s Research Team Publishes Paper in Prestigious International Journal JACS (서강대학교 화학과 옥강민 교수 연구팀,국제 저명 학술지 JACS에 논문 게재)
item.description:
A research team led by Professor Kang Min Ok of the Department of Chemistry at Sogang University (President Jong-hyuk Shim) has successfully developed a new strategy for designing inorganic optical crystals that achieve ultrahigh birefringence by utilizing the coaxial alignment of linear functional units. (서강대학교(총장 심종혁) 화학과 옥강민 교수 연구팀이 선형(linear) 기능 단위들의 ‘동축 정렬(coaxial alignment)’을 이용해 초고복굴절(ultrahigh birefringence)을 구현하는 새로운 무기 광학 결정 설계 전략을 개발하는 데 성공했다.)

This study is recognized as the first to systematically elucidate that the axial alignment (coaxiality) of linear functional units, rather than the concept of coplanarity, which has been a key criterion in conventional birefringent crystal research, is a core structural factor for maximizing optical anisotropy. In particular, it presents a new paradigm for the design of materials for next-generation optical devices by proposing a purely inorganic crystalline system that simultaneously achieves ultraviolet (UV) transmittance and ultrahigh birefringence. (이번 연구는 기존 복굴절 결정 연구에서 핵심 기준으로 사용되어 온 ‘평면성(coplanarity)’ 개념을 넘어, 선형 기능 단위들의 축 방향 정렬(coaxiality)이 광학 이방성을 극대화하는 핵심 구조 인자임을 처음으로 체계적으로 규명한 연구로 평가된다. 특히, 자외선(UV) 투과성과 초고복굴절 특성을 동시에 구현한 순수 무기 결정계를 제시함으로써 차세대 광학소자용 소재 설계의 새로운 패러다임을 제시했다.)

()

The research results were led by the Center for Noncentrosymmetric Materials (CNCSM) at Sogang University, with Professor Kang Min Ok serving as the corresponding author, and Dr. Congcong Jin and Dr. Yang Li (West Anhui University, China; PhD graduate of Sogang University’s Chemistry Department) as co-first authors. This study was published in the Journal of the American Chemical Society (JACS, IF = 15.7), one of the most prestigious international journals in the field of chemistry. (연구 결과는 옥강민 교수가 교신저자, Jin Congcong 박사후연구원과 Li Yang 박사후연구원(중국 West Anhui University, 서강대 화학과 박사 졸업)이 제1 저자로 참여했으며, 서강대 비중심대칭 재료 물질 연구단(Center for Noncentrosymmetric Materials, CNCSM) 주도로 수행되었다. 본 연구는 화학 분야 최고 권위 국제 학술지인 Journal of the American Chemical Society (JACS, IF = 15.7)에 게재되었다.)

()

Birefringence is a phenomenon where the refractive index varies depending on the polarization direction of light as it passes through a material, and it is known as a key property in advanced optical technologies such as lasers, optical communications, polarization imaging, precision sensors, and optical memory. Particularly, with the rapid miniaturization and high integration of optical devices, the development of optical crystals that exhibit both large birefringence (Δn ≥ 0.5) and transparency in the UV region has emerged as an important challenge. (복굴절(birefringence)은 빛이 물질을 통과할 때 편광 방향에 따라 굴절률이 달라지는 현상으로, 레이저, 광통신, 편광 이미징, 정밀 센서, 광메모리 등 첨단 광학 기술의 핵심 물성으로 알려져 있다. 특히 최근 광학소자의 소형화 및 고집적화가 빠르게 진행되면서, 큰 복굴절(Δn ≥ 0.5)을 가지면서도 자외선 영역에서 투명한 광학 결정 개발이 중요한 과제로 부상하고 있다.)

()

However, most existing high-performance birefringent crystals have been focused on organic or organic-inorganic hybrid materials. It has been difficult to simultaneously achieve these properties in purely inorganic crystals, which offer superior chemical stability and mechanical strength. Furthermore, existing design strategies have primarily relied on the coplanar alignment of planar π-conjugated molecules, leaving new design principles based on linear functional units largely unexplored. (그러나 기존 고성능 복굴절 결정의 대부분은 유기 또는 유·무기 하이브리드 물질에 집중되어 있었으며, 화학적 안정성과 기계적 강도가 우수한 순수 무기 결정에서는 이러한 특성을 동시에 구현하기 어려웠다. 또한 기존 설계 전략은 주로 평면형 π-공액 분자들의 평면 정렬(coplanarity)에 의존하고 있어, 선형 기능 단위를 기반으로 한 새로운 설계 원리는 거의 확립되지 않은 상태였다.)

()

To address this, the research team systematically synthesized four UV-transparent inorganic crystals—NH₄Cl·HgCl₂ (1), HgCl(SCN) (2), Hg(SCN)₂ (3), and NH₄Hg(SCN)₃ (4)—using a strategy that progressively substituted chloride ions (Cl⁻) with linear thiocyanate anions (SCN⁻). (이에 연구팀은 염화물(Cl‒)을 선형 티오시아네이트(SCN‒) 음이온으로 단계적으로 치환하는 전략을 통해 NH4Cl·HgCl2(1), HgCl(SCN)(2), Hg(SCN)2(3), NH4Hg(SCN)3(4)의 네 가지 자외선 투명 무기 결정을 체계적으로 합성하였다.)

()

Notably, Hg(SCN)₂ (3) exhibited an experimental birefringence value of Δn = 0.720 at 546 nm (calculated Δn = 0.754), setting a world-record level of optical anisotropy among currently reported purely inorganic UV birefringent crystals. It also maintained a wide bandgap of 3.53 eV, successfully achieving both high birefringence and UV transmission properties. (특히 Hg(SCN)2(3)는 546nm에서 Δn = 0.720의 실험 복굴절값(계산값 Δn = 0.754)을 나타내어, 현재 보고된 순수 무기 자외선 복굴절 결정 중 세계 최고 수준의 광학 이방성을 기록하였다. 또한 3.53eV의 넓은 밴드갭을 동시에 유지하여, 높은 복굴절성과 자외선 투과 특성을 함께 구현하는 데 성공했다.)

()

Through precise structural analysis and Response Electron Distribution Anisotropy (REDA) theoretical calculations, the research team revealed that ultrahigh birefringence cannot be achieved simply by increasing the density of functional units; rather, the degree to which linear functional units are coaxially aligned plays a decisive role. (연구팀은 정밀한 구조 분석과 REDA(Response Electron Distribution Anisotropy) 이론 계산을 통해, 단순히 기능 단위의 밀도를 높이는 것만으로는 초고복굴절이 구현되지 않으며, 선형 기능 단위들이 동일 축 방향으로 얼마나 정렬되는지(coaxiality)가 결정적인 역할을 한다는 사실을 규명하였다.)

()

Interestingly, in the case of NH₄Hg(SCN)₃ (4)—despite its very high density of functional units and excellent coplanarity—it was observed that the birefringence value decreased because the linear modules were not aligned along the same axis. This is an important result demonstrating that the conventional ‘coplanarity-centered design principle’ cannot explain birefringent systems based on linear functional units. (흥미롭게도 NH4Hg(SCN)3(4)의 경우, 기능 단위의 밀도는 매우 높고 평면 정렬성 또한 우수했음에도 불구하고, 선형 모듈들이 동일 축 방향으로 배열되지 않아 복굴절 값이 감소하는 현상이 관찰되었다. 이는 기존의 ‘평면성 중심 설계 원리’만으로는 선형 기능 단위 기반 복굴절 시스템을 설명할 수 없음을 보여주는 중요한 결과이다.)

()

Through this study, the research team proposed a new structure-property correlation, transitioning from the ‘conventional coplanarity-driven design’ based on planar modules to a ‘coaxiality-driven design’ of linear modules. Specifically, they introduced the concept of ‘molecular-level dimensionality reduction,’ which simplifies functional units from planar to linear structures, along with a mechanism for high-density integration of these units, presenting a new direction for achieving ultrahigh birefringence. (연구팀은 이번 연구를 통해 기존의 ‘평면 모듈 기반 복굴절 설계(coplanarity-driven design)’에서 ‘선형 모듈의 동축 정렬(coaxiality-driven design)’로 이어지는 새로운 구조-물성 상관관계를 제시하였다. 특히 기능 단위를 평면 구조에서 선형 구조로 단순화하는 ‘분자 수준 차원 축소(molecular-level dimensionality reduction)’ 개념과, 이에 따른 기능 단위 고밀도 집적 메커니즘을 함께 제안함으로써 초고복굴절 구현의 새로운 방향성을 제시하였다.)

Professor Kang Min Ok explained, “This study is the first case to systematically elucidate how the spatial alignment of linear functional units governs birefringence,” adding, “By proposing coaxiality as a new structural factor, we have established a novel theoretical and experimental foundation for designing next-generation UV optical crystals.” He further emphasized, “The developed materials simultaneously possess high optical anisotropy and UV transmission properties, along with the excellent stability characteristic of purely inorganic crystals, making them highly promising for applications in various advanced optical fields such as next-generation laser optical devices, polarization control units, optical communications, and UV optical systems.” (옥강민 교수는 “이번 연구는 선형 기능 단위들의 공간적 정렬 방식이 복굴절을 어떻게 지배하는지를 체계적으로 규명한 첫 사례”라며, “특히 동축 정렬(coaxiality)을 새로운 구조 인자로 제시함으로써 차세대 자외선 광학 결정 설계를 위한 새로운 이론적·실험적 기반을 마련했다”라고 설명했다. 이어 “개발된 물질은 높은 광학 이방성과 자외선 투과 특성을 동시에 가지면서도 순수 무기 결정 특유의 우수한 안정성을 지니고 있어, 차세대 레이저 광학소자, 편광 제어 장치, 광통신 및 자외선 광학 시스템 등 다양한 첨단 광학 분야에 응용될 가능성이 크다”라고 강조했다.)

item.title: Professor Jo Hyeon-soo of Myongji University Donates 100 Million Won in Development Funds (명지대 조현수 교수, 발전기금 1억 원 기부)
item.description:
Professor Jo Hyeon-soo of Myongji University (President Lim Yeon-soo) donated 100 million won in development funds to the university during a donation ceremony held on June 1 (Monday) in the conference room on the 8th floor of the Creative Arts Hall at the Natural Campus. (명지대학교(총장 임연수) 조현수 교수가 6월 1일(월) 자연캠퍼스 창조예술관 8층 대회의실에서 열린 발전기금 전달식을 통해 명지대학교 발전기금 1억 원을 기부했다.)

Attending the event were President Lim Yeon-soo, along with the Vice President for Academic Affairs, Vice President for Administration, Dean of the College of Sports and Arts, and other university officials. The ceremony proceeded in order: opening remarks led by Director Shin Taek-soo of the Office of External Cooperation, a prayer, introduction of Professor Jo Hyeon-soo, presentation of the development funds, delivery of a plaque of appreciation and a bouquet, words of gratitude (by President Lim Yeon-soo), a speech (by donor Jo Hyeon-soo), group photography, and a closing declaration. (이날 행사에는 임연수 총장을 비롯한 교학부총장, 행정부총장, 스포츠·예술대학장, 실처장 등 학교 관계자들이 참석했으며, 대외협력처 신택수 처장의 사회로 개식, 기도, 조현수 교수 소개, 발전기금 전달, 감사패 및 꽃다발 전달, 감사 인사(임연수 총장), 인사말(조현수 기부자), 사진 촬영, 폐회선언 순으로 진행됐다.)

()

Professor Jo Hyeon-soo has served as a professor in the Keyboard Music Major of the Art & Multimedia Music Division at Myongji University since 1994, dedicating himself to student education and the advancement of music arts. After graduating from Seoul National University, he earned a master's degree from Temple University in the United States and a doctoral degree from Minnesota State University. In addition to his teaching and research, he has consistently contributed to the development of the domestic music scene through various performance activities. (조현수 교수는 1994년부터 명지대학교 아트앤멀티미디어음악학부 건반음악전공 교수로 재직하며 학생 교육과 음악예술 발전에 힘써왔다. 서울대학교를 졸업한 후 미국 Temple University에서 석사 학위, Minnesota State University에서 박사 학위를 취득했으며, 교육과 연구뿐 아니라 다양한 연주 활동을 통해 국내 음악계 발전에도 꾸준히 기여해 왔다.)

()

In particular, he has actively performed on diverse stages, including regular concerts of the French Music Research Society, duo concerts, and regular concerts of Camerata Jeonnam. Last year, he participated in a performance titled "Intergenerational Dialogue on the Keyboard," showcasing the value of communication and empathy across generations through music. (특히 프랑스음악연구회 정기연주회, 듀오 콘서트, 카메라타전남 정기연주회 등 다양한 무대에서 활발한 연주 활동을 이어왔으며, 지난해에는 ‘건반으로 그리는 세대 간의 대화’ 공연에 참여해 음악을 통한 세대 간 소통과 공감의 가치를 선보인 바 있다.)

()

Professor Jo Hyeon-soo stated, "I decided to donate these development funds with the hope of contributing even a little to the growth of Myongji University, where I have spent a long time," adding, "I hope that students can nurture their dreams in a better environment and that it helps the university continue to grow." (조현수 교수는 “오랜 시간 몸담아 온 명지대학교의 발전에 조금이나마 보탬이 되기를 바라는 마음으로 발전기금을 기탁하게 됐다”며 “학생들이 더 좋은 환경에서 자신의 꿈을 키워나가고, 대학이 지속적으로 성장하는 데 도움이 되기를 바란다”고 말했다.)

()

President Lim Yeon-soo expressed, "Professor Jo Hyeon-soo has not only devoted himself to student education and the development of music arts for a long time but has also contributed precious development funds for the future of the university," adding, "His valuable sharing will greatly empower students to realize their dreams and talents, and Myongji University will deeply cherish his intentions and repay them through the advancement of education and the arts." (임연수 총장은 “조현수 교수님께서는 오랜 기간 학생 교육과 음악예술 발전을 위해 헌신해 오셨을 뿐 아니라, 대학의 미래를 위해 귀한 발전기금까지 기탁해 주셨다”며 “교수님의 귀한 나눔은 학생들이 자신의 꿈과 재능을 펼쳐나가는 데 큰 힘이 될 것이며, 명지대학교는 그 뜻을 깊이 새기고 교육과 예술 발전으로 보답하겠다”고 전했다.)

Meanwhile, the development funds donated by Professor Jo Hyeon-soo to Myongji University are expected to be used as scholarships to support students' academic pursuits and nurture talent. (한편, 조현수 교수가 기탁한 명지대학교 발전기금은 학생들의 학업 지원과 인재 양성을 위한 장학금으로 활용될 예정이다.)

item.title: Old and uncomfortable first-generation KTX restrooms to be remodeled after 22 years (낡고 불편한 1세대 KTX 화장실, 22년 만에 리모델링)
item.description:
All restrooms on the first-generation KTX (KTX-1), introduced 22 years ago, will be upgraded by June next year. (22년전 도입된 1세대 케이티엑스(KTX-1) 화장실이 내년 6월까지 모두 개선된다.)

Korea Railroad Corporation (Korail) announced on the 1st that it held a "KTX restroom improvement review" at the Metropolitan Railway Vehicle Maintenance Center in Goyang, Gyeonggi Province, and began restroom remodeling work. The remodeling targets 46 KTX-1 trainsets introduced in 2004. (한국교통공사(코레일)는 1일 경기 고양시 수도권철도차량정비단에서 ‘케이티엑스 화장실 개선 품평회’를 열고 화장실 리모델링 작업에 들어간다고 밝혔다. 리모델링 대상은 2004년 도입된 케이티엑스-1 46편성이다.)

The restroom improvement work will involve △sanitary upgrades of aged flooring, walls, and washbasin countertops, and △enhancing the design and durability of hand dryers, toilet seat covers, toilet paper dispensers, and ventilation fans. For the flooring, a transparent flame-retardant epoxy will be applied to prevent slipping, and handrails will be installed on the walls. Additionally, the dim restroom lighting will be replaced with LED lights to make them brighter. (화장실 개선 작업은 △노후화된 바닥재·벽면·세면대 상판을 위생적으로 개선하고 △손 건조기·변기 커버·휴지 디스펜서·환풍기의 디자인과 내구성을 강화하는 쪽으로 이뤄진다. 바닥재는 미끄럼 방지를 위해 투명 난연 에폭시를 적용하고, 벽면에는 손잡이를 설치하기로 했다. 또 어두웠던 화장실 조명을 발광 다이오드(LED)로 바꿔서 보다 밝게 바꾸기로 했다.)

Korail stated that it will improve all 828 restrooms across 46 trainsets from this month to June next year. Lee Ki-cheol, head of Korail's vehicle division, said, "We will continue to improve service facilities so that passengers can use trains more comfortably and conveniently." (코레일은 이달부터 내년 6월까지 46개 편성, 총 828개소의 화장실을 모두 개선하겠다고 밝혔다. 이기철 코레일 차량본부장은 “이용객이 더 쾌적하고 편안하게 열차를 이용할 수 있도록 서비스 설비 개선을 지속해 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jeong shin@hani.co.kr (신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Gyeonggi Province and Gyeonggi Tourism Organization Hold 'Gyeonggi Local Travel Partners' Networking Day (경기도-경기관광공사, ‘경기 로컬여행 파트너스’ 네트워킹 데이 개최)
item.description:
Gyeonggi Province and Gyeonggi Tourism Organization are spearheading the revitalization of local tourism through the 'Gyeonggi Local Travel Partners' initiative. (경기도와 경기관광공사가 ‘경기 로컬여행 파트너스’ 사업을 통해 지역 관광 활성화에 나선다.)

()

The Gyeonggi Tourism Organization announced on the 1st that it recently selected 41 participating companies and organizations for the project and held a 'Networking Day' on the afternoon of May 29 (Friday) in the auditorium on the 3rd floor of the Gyeonggi Credit Guarantee Foundation. (경기관광공사는 최근 사업 참여 기업 및 단체 41개소를 선정하고, 지난 5월 29일(금) 오후, 경기신용보증재단 3층 강당에서 ‘네트워킹 데이’를 개최했다고 1일 밝혔다.)

()

At this event, specific business plans were shared with partners, including ▲ city/county-linked meet-up days ▲ development of customized tourism products ▲ joint marketing support, and discussions were held on establishing a cooperation system with participating partner companies. (이번 행사에서는 ▲시·군 연계 밋업데이 ▲맞춤형 관광상품 개발 ▲공동 마케팅 지원 등 구체적 사업 계획을 파트너들과 공유하고, 참여 파트너사와의 협력체계 구축 방안을 논의했다.)

()

In particular, this project goes beyond one-time project-based support, focusing on laying the groundwork for collaboration between tourism entities in 31 cities and counties within the province and private businesses. To this end, a 'Meet-Up Day' event is scheduled for July to provide practical collaboration opportunities between cities/counties and partner companies, promoting the development of region-specific tourism products and services. (특히, 이번 사업은 단순한 프로젝트 일회성 지원을 넘어, 도내 31개 시·군 관광 주체와 민간사업자 간 협업 기반 마련에 중점을 두고 있다. 이를 위해 시·군과 파트너사 간 실질적 협업 기회를 제공, 지역 맞춤형 관광상품 개발 및 서비스 촉진 차원에서 ‘밋업데이’ 행사를 오는 7월에 개최할 예정이다.)

()

Additionally, companies and organizations selected as 'contest-type' partners will receive approximately 70 million won in development support funds for new local travel tourism products, assisting in the commercialization of differentiated tourism content that reflects regional characteristics. (또 ‘공모형’ 파트너스로 선정된 기업·단체를 대상으로 약 7,000만 원 규모의 신규 로컬여행 관광상품 개발 지원금을 제공, 지역 특성을 반영한 차별화 관광콘텐츠 상품화를 지원한다.)

()

An official from the Gyeonggi Tourism Organization stated, "This project will serve as an opportunity to connect the region's unique tourism resources with creative private-sector content, further enhancing the competitiveness of the province's tourism industry," adding, "I hope that collaboration through the Local Travel Partners will open new pathways for regional tourism." (경기관광공사 관계자는 "이번 사업이 지역 고유의 관광자원을 민간의 창의적 콘텐츠와 연결해 도내 관광산업의 경쟁력을 한층 높이는 계기가 될 것"이라며, "로컬여행 파트너스를 통한 협업이 지역관광의 새로운 활로가 되길 바란다"고 말했다.)

item.title: Financial Authorities' Conservative Stance Stifles Leap in Korea's Capital Market (금융당국 보수적 태도, 한국 자본시장 도약 틀어막는다)
item.description:
Lee Yong-woo, Former Democratic Party Lawmaker (이용우 민주당 전 의원)

Our capital market is in the spotlight. The "KOSPI 10,000" level, once a distant dream just a year ago, now seems within reach. While adjustments may follow, as the adage "high mountains have deep valleys" suggests, the market's underlying strength in this upward trend is fundamentally different from before. The starting point was the amendment to Article 382-3 of the Commercial Act regarding directors' duty of loyalty. This amendment aims to prevent conglomerate controlling shareholders from pushing through reckless investments via the board without due business consideration, which could lead to the insolvency of not just the company but also its affiliates, ultimately shifting the burden onto ordinary shareholders. By passing the National Assembly plenary session in July 2025, it clarified that the purpose of corporate management is to enhance overall shareholder value, not maximize the interests of controlling shareholders, transforming the market into one where ordinary shareholders can invest with confidence. <<> The core issue of the Commercial Act amendment became centered on conflicts of interest among shareholders, triggered by the "spin-off listings" of LG Chem's and SK's secondary battery subsidiaries. The Financial Services Commission's (FSC) announcement, as part of measures to stabilize and normalize the capital market, to principally prohibit overlapping listings and allow them only under strict, exceptional criteria, stems from the same context. This points to the practice being exploited by controlling shareholders to expand their business while maintaining management control with a small equity stake, and aims to improve the asymmetrical structure where listing benefits are concentrated among a few. The FSC has established a mechanism requiring the parent company's board to assess the impact of a subsidiary's listing on shareholders and devise protective measures as a tool to fulfill the duty of loyalty. <<> Market operators and facilitators (such as the FSC, Financial Supervisory Service, and Korea Exchange) are the entities responsible for establishing market norms, i.e., "soft law," that align with this. Soft law arises from the question, "Is this legally feasible?" While not explicitly codified in law, it forms a norm through the process of assessing that feasibility. An open process where market participants and facilitators can freely ask questions and seek their meaning is a prerequisite. What facilitators must provide to participants are the criteria for market participation, and if disputes arise over these criteria, the issues must be promptly disclosed and solutions sought collaboratively. However, our reality is that when market participants encounter novel issues or matters not clearly defined in legal principles, they merely probe the feasibility through inquiries for administrative interpretation similar to authoritative legal rulings from facilitators. Can new norms truly be accumulated smoothly in an environment where facilitators and participants perceive a superior-subordinate relationship? <<> We are now in the process of creating new market norms for a market changed by the Commercial Act amendment. It is time to move beyond a rigid normative system and accumulate soft law through free discussion. For example, the FSC's policy of principally prohibiting overlapping listings is based on the overarching principle that if there is a conflict of interest among investors, overlapping listings are not permitted, and institutional arrangements must be established to resolve the conflict and obtain consent for an exception. This norm should be established by the facilitator actively gathering opinions from the company in question, its affiliates, and relevant experts. <<> A prime example of establishing such a new benchmark is the creation of the "technology special listing" pathway to facilitate capital raising for technology-driven companies, even those with losses, such as in the biotech sector. Of course, even among these biotech companies, there have been cases of management embezzlement, breach of trust, or crises arising from financial investment losses rather than technology development. In response, it would be problematic to claim that the listing standards were fundamentally flawed or the review was negligent, and thus blame the KOSPI/KOSDAQ markets or underwriters. Such a culture makes it difficult to autonomously create soft law and develop new market practices through it. If the FSC's policy of principally prohibiting overlapping listings is interpreted merely as a routine ban to avoid such controversies, it will inevitably be criticized for delaying listing reviews and hindering corporate growth. <<> Not all overlapping listings need to be banned. Some are "asymmetrical overlapping listings" that effectively pass losses only to the parent company's ordinary shareholders following a physical spin-off. Others, however, involve independent business models with separate management structures, seeking both capital raising efficiency and corporate value discovery. For instance, a listed company could venture into entirely new industries—such as high-bandwidth memory (HBM) packaging technology borrowing weaving methods from the textile industry, or DNA synthesis using inkjet printer principles—providing opportunities for investment and expansion. <<> What is needed, however, are review principles. Mechanisms should be established, such as prior explanation procedures for the parent company's ordinary shareholders, methods for soliciting minority shareholder opinions, consideration of priority allocation or alternative compensation, limits and monitoring of related-party transactions post-listing, operation of independent outside directors or special committees, and follow-up disclosure obligations for a certain period after listing. Since the nature of conflicts of interest varies case by case, it is crucial to first present minimum standards and then flexibly adjust additional safeguards on a case-by-case basis. <<> Similar issues to overlapping listings are now emerging with the listing of venture companies holding multiple voting rights. The controversy surrounding multiple voting rights among venture firms pursuing listings starkly reveals the rigid operational practices of relevant authorities. Citing the burden of handling their first-ever review of a company with multiple voting rights, the reviewing authorities have been demanding that such companies eliminate these rights. <<> During discussions in the 21st National Assembly on introducing multiple voting rights for venture companies, there were calls for necessary safeguards: if multiple voting rights are granted, they must be clearly disclosed, and the conditions for their dissolution should be stipulated in the articles of incorporation, allowing the market to properly price them. While multiple voting rights violate the one-share-one-vote principle and risk infringing on the rights of ordinary shareholders, they are necessary for innovative technology companies to vest responsibility in founders when their equity stakes have been significantly diluted through multiple rounds of capital raising. Market Kurly is a prime example. During its growth, Market Kurly continuously attracted external capital, diluting the founder's stake to just 5-6%. If financial investors pursue an exit after listing, the governance structure could become extremely unstable. This structure could undermine the founder's management philosophy or lead to a focus on short-term profits, harming ordinary shareholders. In such situations, multiple voting rights are necessary. However, instead of supporting Market Kurly to design creative shareholder protection measures considering its unique circumstances, the reviewing authorities treated the low equity stake itself as a disqualifying factor and consistently delayed the review process. <<> For the development of Korea's capital market, a change in attitude from regulatory bodies and market facilitators must precede any legal overhaul. Simply banning overlapping listings and shying away from multiple voting rights will not resolve the "Korea Discount." <<> First, relevant authorities must proactively act as mediators for conflicts of interest. They should pre-emptively identify potential conflict points, publicize them, and clearly provide "minimum guidelines" for the protective measures companies must present. This would enhance the predictability of listings for companies and open pathways for capital raising. <<> Second, there must be a paradigm shift toward "disclosure-centered regulation." Given the expanded duty of loyalty for directors, companies should be required to transparently disclose the basis for board decisions and shareholder protection efforts, allowing the market to evaluate them. If problems arise, letting the market reflect them in prices or filtering them through shareholder meetings aligns with capitalist principles. <<> Third, internal innovation is needed to overcome a "practical risk-aversion" culture. The practice of delaying reviews to avoid responsibility for new systems or unprecedented cases erodes the capital market's competitiveness. Review systems should be built with specialized personnel and the flexibility to handle innovative governance models. <<> Fourth, a market culture that does not fear legal disputes must be fostered. Based on the strengthened duty of loyalty, shareholders should actively exercise their rights, allowing legal precedents formed through this process to become market norms. item.title: Chung-Ang University's Department of Theater Arts Wins Best Work Award and Outstanding Acting Awards at Asian Theatre Schools Festival (중앙대학교 연극학과, 아시아 연극대학 페스티벌에서 최우수 작품상·우수 연기상 수상)
item.description:
Chung-Ang University (President Park Se-hyun) announced on the 1st that its Department of Theater Arts won the Best Work Award and two Outstanding Acting Awards at the 8th Asian Theatre Schools Festival. (중앙대학교(총장 박세현) 연극학과는 1일 ‘제8회 아시아 연극대학 페스티벌(The 8th Asian Theatre Schools Festival)’에서 최우수 작품상과 2개의 우수 연기상을 수상했다고 밝혔다.)

Hosted by the Asian Theatre Education Centre (ATEC) and organized by The Central Academy of Drama in Beijing, China, the Department of Theater Arts' production of <Candida> was honored with the Best Work Award. Additionally, student Kim Na-hyeon, who played the role of Candida, and student Im Gyeol, who performed as Morell, each received Outstanding Acting Awards. (아시아연극교육센터(ATEC)가 주최하고 중국 북경 중앙희극학원(The Central Academy of Drama)이 주관한 이번 축제에서, 중앙대 연극학과의 작품 <캔디다>가 최우수 작품상으로 선정되는 영예를 안았다. 이와 함께 캔디다 역을 맡은 김나현 학생과 몰렐 역을 연기한 임결 학생이 각각 우수 연기상을 받았다.)

Jung Da-eun, a student from the Department of Theater Arts who directed the play, shared her directorial intent, saying, "We prepared a stage that carefully excavates the hidden secrets within the gaps of others' realms that we could never have known. Through this work, I wanted to trace the answers to questions like what true companionship is, what love is, and what existence itself means, together with the audience." (연출을 맡은 연극학과 정다은 학생은 “우리가 결코 알 수 없었던 타인의 영역, 그 틈새에 숨겨진 비밀을 조심스럽게 파헤쳐보는 무대를 준비했다”며, “이번 작품을 통해 진정한 동반자란 무엇인가, 사랑이란 무엇인가, 그리고 나라는 존재는 무엇인가라는 질문의 답을 관객과 함께 추적하고 싶었다”고 연출 의도를 전했다.)

Professor Choi Jae-oh of the Department of Theater Arts, who serves as Vice Chair of the Asian Theatre Education Centre (ATEC), stated, "At this year's festival, held in celebration of the 170th anniversary of playwright George Bernard Shaw's birth, the students' <Candida>—which filled a clean, empty stage with just a single desk and a few chairs through beautiful and delicate acting—received a great response." (아시아연극교육센터(ATEC) 부이사장인 최재오 연극학과 교수는 “극작가 조지 버나드 쇼의 탄생 170주년을 기념하며 열린 올해 페스티벌에서, 책상 하나와 몇 개의 의자만 사용한 깔끔한 빈 무대를 아름답고 섬세한 연기로 채운 학생들의 <캔디다>가 큰 호응을 받았다”고 밝혔다.)

The Asian Theatre Education Centre (ATEC), which organized this festival, consists of 19 member schools from 12 countries worldwide, including South Korea, the United States, China, Japan, and Singapore, and leads global theatre education through continuous exchanges. (이번 페스티벌을 주최한 아시아연극교육센터(ATEC)은 한국, 미국, 중국, 일본, 싱가포르 등 세계 12개국 19개교가 가입해 지속적으로 교류하며 세계 연극 교육을 이끌고 있다.)

item.title: Soongsil University Launches G-LAMP Project Group, Accelerating Innovation in Basic Science Research (숭실대, G-LAMP사업단 개소… 기초과학 연구 혁신 본격화)
item.description:
Soongsil University (President Yoon Jae Lee) announced that its G-LAMP Project Group held the "Soongsil University G-LAMP Project Group Launch Ceremony" on May 28 at the university's Hyeongnam Hall, marking the official start of efforts to innovate basic science research and cultivate future convergent talents. (숭실대학교(총장 이윤재) G-LAMP사업단은 5월 28일 숭실대 형남홀에서 ‘숭실대학교 G-LAMP사업단 개소식’을 열고 기초과학 연구 혁신과 미래 융합인재 양성을 위한 공식 출범을 알렸다고 밝혔다.)

Approximately 100 people attended the event, including officials from the Ministry of Education, Yoo Jae-joon, President of the National Association of College of Natural Sciences Deans, officials from G-LAMP Project Groups at other universities, the president of Soongsil University and key administrators, participating faculty and researchers, and graduate students. The ceremony featured a welcome speech by the president of Soongsil University, an encouraging address by Yoo Jae-joon, President of the National Association of College of Natural Sciences Deans, and a congratulatory speech by Chae Hong-joon, Director of the Ministry of Education. (이날 행사에는 교육부 관계자를 비롯해 유재준 전국자연과학대학장협의회장, 타 대학 G-LAMP사업단 관계자, 숭실대 총장 및 주요 보직자, 참여 교수진과 연구원, 대학원생 등 100여 명이 참석했다. 행사에서는 숭실대 총장 환영사와 유재준 전국자연과학대학장협의회장 격려사, 채홍준 교육부 과장 축사 등이 이어졌다.)

The G-LAMP (Global Leading University for Basic Sciences and Interdisciplinary Research) project is a university basic research support program funded by the Ministry of Education and the National Research Foundation of Korea. It aims to strengthen universities' basic science research capabilities and foster a world-class research ecosystem. (G-LAMP사업은 교육부와 한국연구재단이 지원하는 대학 기초연구 지원사업이다. 대학의 기초과학 연구역량을 강화하고 세계 수준의 연구 생태계를 조성하는 것을 목표로 한다.)

The G-LAMP Project Group at Soongsil University plans to build a creative research environment centered on AI, bio, and data-based convergent research, and focus on nurturing the next generation of research talent. It will also expand industry-academia-research cooperation networks and promote joint research and academic exchanges to strengthen basic science research capabilities and cultivate future convergent talents. (숭실대 G-LAMP사업단은 AI·바이오·데이터 기반 융합연구를 중심으로 창의적인 연구 환경을 구축하고 차세대 연구인재 양성에 힘쓸 계획이다. 또 기초과학 분야 연구역량 강화와 미래 융합인재 양성을 위해 산·학·연 협력 네트워크를 확대하고 공동연구 및 학술 교류 활성화에도 나설 예정이다.)

In particular, the project group will pursue the expansion of global joint research, the establishment of international cooperation networks, the enhancement of undergraduate and graduate student research capabilities, and the creation of advanced research infrastructure. It also plans to operate high school-linked basic science education and mentoring programs to build a research and education platform connected with the local community. (특히 사업단은 글로벌 공동연구 확대와 국제 협력 네트워크 구축, 학부생·대학원생 연구역량 강화, 첨단 연구 인프라 조성 등을 추진한다. 또한 고교 연계 기초과학 교육 및 멘토링 프로그램을 운영해 지역사회와 연계한 연구·교육 플랫폼도 구축해 나갈 방침이다.)

Kang Wi-kyung, Head of the Soongsil University G-LAMP Project Group, stated, "With this launch ceremony as a catalyst, we will further expand convergence research based on basic sciences and global cooperation," adding, "We will do our utmost to cultivate outstanding research talents who will lead future science and technology." (강위경 숭실대 G-LAMP사업단장은 “이번 개소식을 계기로 기초과학 기반 융합연구와 글로벌 협력을 더욱 확대하겠다”며 “미래 과학기술을 이끌 우수 연구인재 양성에 최선을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the Soongsil University G-LAMP Project Group plans to expand its cooperation network with domestic and international research institutions, operate various academic and educational programs, and accelerate efforts to strengthen research competitiveness. (한편 숭실대 G-LAMP사업단은 앞으로 국내외 연구기관과 협력 네트워크를 넓히고 다양한 학술·교육 프로그램을 운영하며 연구 경쟁력 강화에 속도를 낼 계획이다.)

item.title: National Future Strategy Institute: "Carbon Neutrality Must Shift from Environmental Policy to National Competitiveness Strategy" (국가미래전략원 “탄소중립, 환경정책에서 국가경쟁력 전략으로 전환”)
item.description:
A proposal has emerged to move South Korea's carbon neutrality discussions beyond emission reduction targets or the expansion of renewable energy, integrating electricity, hydrogen, steel, artificial intelligence, data, and balanced regional development into a single industrial ecosystem strategy and redesigning it as a "national competitiveness strategy." (우리나라 탄소중립 논의를 감축 목표 설정이나 재생에너지 확대 중심에서 벗어나, 전력·수소·철강·인공지능·데이터·지역균형발전을 하나의 산업 생태계 전략으로 통합해 ‘국가 경쟁력 전략’으로 재설계 해야 한다는 제안이 나온다.)

On the 1st, the Seoul National University National Future Strategy Institute (Director Kang Won-taek) published a national policy proposal report titled "Industrial and Security Strategy of Carbon Neutrality and Korea's Green Transition (K-GX)," which argues that the implementation strategy for the Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) should shift from being goal-oriented to an execution-focused industrial transformation. The proposal suggests that carbon neutrality should go beyond a simple "environmental policy" centered on greenhouse gas reduction targets, being redesigned as a national competitiveness strategy that integrates industrial competitiveness, energy security, and the transformation of advanced manufacturing combined with artificial intelligence (AI). (1일 서울대 국가미래전략원(원장 강원택)이 내놓은 국가정책 제안 보고서인 ‘탄소중립의 산업·안보 전략화와 한국형 녹색전환(K-GX)’은 국가온실가스 감축 목표(NDC) 이행 전략을 목표 중심에서 실행 중심의 산업전환으로 바꿔야 한다고 주장한다. 탄소중립은 단순히 온실가스 감축 목표 중심의 탄소중립 ‘환경정책’을 넘어, 산업 경쟁력과 에너지 안보, 인공지능(AI)이 결합된 첨단 제조업 전환을 통합한 국가 경쟁력 전략으로 재설계돼야 한다는 제안이다.)

According to this report, jointly researched and authored by academics including Seoul National University Professor Yun Je-yong (Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering), major countries are maintaining their greenhouse gas reduction targets while simultaneously protecting their domestic industries, strategically utilizing fossil fuels, and securing critical supply chains. The report states, "Climate policy is transforming into a national strategic instrument combined with industrial competitiveness, energy security, and technological leadership," and proposes, "Beyond subsidy-centered industrial policy, an integrated industrial ecosystem design that fuses electricity, hydrogen, and artificial intelligence is required." (윤제용 서울대 교수(화학생물공학부) 등 학계 연구자들이 공동 연구·작성한 이 보고서를 보면, 주요국들은 온실가스 감축 목표를 유지하면서도 자국 산업 보호, 전략적인 화석연료 활용, 핵심 공급망 확보를 병행하고 있다. 보고서는 “기후정책은 산업 경쟁력·에너지 안보·기술 주도권과 결합된 국가 전략 수단으로 전환되고 있다”며 “보조금 중심 산업정책을 넘어, 전력·수소·인공지능을 융합하는 통합적 산업 생태계 설계가 요구된다”고 제안했다.)

The report suggests that if the 2035 national greenhouse gas reduction target is the agenda, then Korea's Green Transition is a framework to convert this into an industrial growth strategy that also considers economic benefits. It proposes, "Responses to the climate crisis should be approached not as a cost burden, but as an opportunity to secure low-carbon manufacturing competitiveness and create new markets." To achieve this, it argues that the structure of Korea's Green Transition should consist of three main pillars: △ Energy Transition (carbon-free electricity supply and preemptive grid construction) △ Industrial Transition (process innovation in hard-to-abate industries and creation of new markets) △ System Transition (integrated design of infrastructure based on electricity, hydrogen, artificial intelligence, and data). (보고서는 2035년 국가 온실가스 감축 목표가 의제라면, 한국형 녹색전환은 이를 경제적 실리까지 고려하는 산업 성장전략으로 전환하는 프레임이라며, “기후위기 대응을 비용 부담이 아니라 저탄소 제조 경쟁력 확보와 신시장 창출의 기회로 접근해야 한다”고 제안했다. 또 이를 위해 한국형 녹색전환 구조를 △에너지 전환(무탄소 전력 공급 및 전력망 선제 구축) △산업 전환(감축이 어려운 산업의 공정 혁신 및 신시장 창출) △시스템 전환(전력·수소·인공지능·데이터 기반 인프라의 통합 설계) 등 3대 축으로 구성해야 한다고 주장한다.)

As an agenda to implement these three pillars, the report presents '5+1 Priority Tasks'. The five priority tasks are: △ Competitive transformation to carbon-free electricity △ Accelerating decarbonization of major manufacturing industries, centered on steel △ Building a phased hydrogen supply portfolio △ Balanced regional development and GX (Green Transformation) transition △ Establishing a market ecosystem that attracts voluntary inflow of private capital. Furthermore, it proposes the need to integrate an AI and data-based policy transformation as a cross-cutting execution foundation for these five tasks. (이런 3대 축을 실행할 의제로는 ‘5+1 우선과제’를 제시했다. △경쟁력 있는 무탄소 전력 대전환 △철강 중심으로 주력 제조업의 탈탄소 전환 가속화 △단계별 수소 공급 포트폴리오 구축 △지역 균형 발전과 GX 전환 △민간자본이 자발적으로 유입되는 시장 생태계 구축이 5대 우선 과제라는 것이다. 나아가, 5대 과제를 횡단하는 실행 기반으로 인공지능·데이터 기반 정책 전환이 결합될 필요가 있다고 제안했다.)

The National Future Strategy Institute stated, "South Korea's implementation strategy for its national greenhouse gas reduction targets has been pursued by first setting reduction goals and then supplementing the means later. However, to enhance execution capability, the design approach must be switched to pre-reflect the timing, cost structure, and industrial ripple effects of introducing carbon dioxide reduction technologies." It added, "Korea's Green Transition must be redefined as a national competitiveness strategy that restructures the country's energy and industrial framework." (국가미래전략원은 “우리나라 국가온실가스 감축목표 이행 전략이 그동안 감축 목표를 먼저 설정하고 그 수단은 나중에 보완하는 방식으로 추진됐으나, 실행력을 높이려면 이산화탄소 감축 기술을 도입하는 시기와 비용 구조, 산업 파급효과를 사전에 반영하는 설계 방식으로 전환해야 한다”며, “한국형 녹색전환은 우리나라 에너지·산업 구조를 재편하는 국가 경쟁력 전략으로 재정의돼야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Kye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Seoul National University of Science and Technology's Early Employment Contract Department Hosts Special Lecture by Professor Jeong Jae-seung (서울시립대 조기취업형 계약학과, 정재승 교수 초청 특별강연 성료)
item.description:
The Early Employment Contract Department project team at Seoul National University of Science and Technology (President Won Yong-geol) held a department information session and special lecture on May 29 for prospective freshmen and current students. (서울시립대학교(총장 원용걸) 조기취업형 계약학과 사업단은 5월 29일 예비 신입생, 재학생 등을 대상으로 학과설명회 및 특별강연을 개최했다.)

This event was designed to introduce the curriculum and achievements of the Early Employment Contract Department and to provide opportunities for science and engineering talents, who will lead future industries, to explore career paths and prepare for the future. (이번 행사는 조기취업형 계약학과의 교육과정과 성과를 소개하고, 미래 산업을 이끌어갈 이공계 인재들에게 진로 탐색과 미래 준비의 기회를 제공하기 위해 마련되었다.)

In the first part, the department information session introduced the graduate school's Biohealth and Eco-Convergence Department curriculum, industry-academia research projects, corporate-linked education operation systems, and student support programs. In particular, it drew attention by sharing cases of curriculum operation reflecting industrial field demands and the cultivation of practical master's-level talent through joint corporate-university research. (1부 학과설명회에서는 대학원 바이오헬스‧에코융합학과의 교육과정, 산학협력 기반 연구 프로젝트, 기업 연계 교육 운영 체계, 학생 지원제도 등을 소개하였다. 특히 산업 현장의 수요를 반영한 교육과정 운영과 기업·대학 공동연구를 통한 실무형 석사급 인재 양성 사례를 공유하며 참석자들의 관심을 모았다.)

In the second part, Professor Jeong Jae-seung, a leading domestic neuroscientist, gave a special lecture titled "Reflecting on the Future of Science and Engineering through Neuroscience in the Age of Artificial Intelligence." (이어 2부에서는 국내 대표 뇌과학자인 정재승 교수가 「인공지능시대, 뇌과학으로 이공계의 미래를 성찰하다」를 주제로 특별강연을 진행하였다.)

Professor Jeong explained the impact of the development of artificial intelligence technology on industry and society, emphasizing the importance of creativity, convergent thinking, and problem-solving capabilities that future science and engineering talents should possess. He also highlighted the unique thinking abilities and learning capacities inherent to humans from a neuroscience perspective, explaining that human-centered insight and the ability to ask questions will become key to future competitiveness amid technological advancements. (정 교수는 인공지능 기술의 발전이 산업과 사회에 미치는 영향을 설명하며, 미래 이공계 인재가 갖추어야 할 창의성, 융합적 사고, 문제해결 역량의 중요성을 강조했다. 또한 뇌과학적 관점에서 인간만이 가진 고유한 사고 능력과 학습 역량을 조명하며, 기술 발전 속에서도 인간 중심의 통찰과 질문하는 능력이 미래 경쟁력의 핵심이 될 것이라고 설명했다.)

During the Q&A session following the lecture, students raised various questions about career choices, job changes in the age of artificial intelligence, and the ideal future talent profile. Participants gained new perspectives and insights into the future society through this meaningful time. (강연 후 진행된 질의응답 시간에는 진로 선택, 인공지능 시대의 직업 변화, 미래 인재상 등에 대한 학생들의 다양한 질문이 이어졌으며, 참석자들은 미래 사회를 바라보는 새로운 시각과 통찰을 얻는 뜻깊은 시간을 가졌다.)

The Early Employment Contract Department at Seoul National University of Science and Technology operates as an industry-education integrated model where students are hired by partner companies upon admission, combining academic study with practical work. It has achieved high employment rates and corporate satisfaction by cultivating practical talent demanded by the industrial field. (서울시립대학교 조기취업형 계약학과는 학생이 입학과 동시에 참여기업에 채용되어 학업과 실무를 병행하는 산학일체형 교육모델로 운영되고 있으며, 산업 현장에서 요구하는 실무형 인재 양성을 통해 높은 취업률과 기업 만족도를 달성하고 있다.)

Jeong Yeon-du, head of the Early Employment Contract Department project team, said, "Through this event, prospective freshmen have gained a better understanding of the Early Employment Contract Department and insights into future industrial changes," adding, "We will continue to focus on nurturing key talent that will lead future industries through excellent educational programs and diverse industry-academia collaboration activities." (정연두 조기취업형 계약학과 사업단장은 “이번 행사를 통해 예비 신입생들이 조기취업형 계약학과에 대한 이해를 높이고, 미래 산업 변화에 대한 통찰을 얻는 계기가 되었다”며 “앞으로도 우수한 교육 프로그램과 다양한 산학협력 활동을 통해 미래 산업을 선도할 핵심 인재 양성에 힘쓰겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Currently, the Early Employment Contract Department at Seoul National University of Science and Technology operates the Biohealth and Eco-Convergence Department. Based on the recruitment-linked selection of all participating students and high employment outcomes, it has established itself as a core talent cultivation model for Seoul's strategic industrial sectors. (서울시립대학교 조기취업형 계약학과는 현재 바이오헬스‧에코융합학과를 운영하고 있으며, 참여학생 전원 채용연계 선발 및 높은 취업성과를 바탕으로 서울시 전략산업 분야의 핵심 인재 양성 모델로 자리매김하고 있다.)
